news.title: Newly appointed Deputy Economy Minister is Erasmus University Rotterdam graduate

summary: Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) is public research university in the Netherlands, founded in 1913. Type: public sector / education / research. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Rotterdam public research university founded in 1913, strong in economics, medicine and law; international and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: About 3,990 staff, focused on Economics and Management, Medicine and Health Sciences, and Law, Culture and Society.
Researchers, teachers, support staff and students share the Woudestein campus, which it describes as lively.
Staff mostly studied economics, psychology, international studies, sociology and law, many at Erasmus itself, Leiden or Utrecht.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam and Erasmus Centre for Entrepreneurship).
All 4 current research jobs here in Rotterdam don't require Dutch, and 3 of 4 show pay.
Calls itself internationally oriented and points staff to Rotterdam's expat desk.

worth_knowing.text: Offers career-development and mobility policies plus training for staff, per its employer profile.
